description: Runs npm/pnpm/yarn install and returns a structured summary of added/removed packages and vulnerabilities. Auto-detects package manager via lock files (pnpm-lock.yaml → pnpm, yarn.lock → yarn, otherwise npm). Lifecycle scripts (preinstall/postinstall) are skipped by default for safety. Set ignoreScripts to false if packages need postinstall scripts to work (e.g., esbuild, sharp).

args.description: Additional arguments (e.g., package names to install)

dryRun.description: Preview what would be installed without actually installing (maps to --dry-run)

exact.description: Save exact versions instead of semver ranges (maps to --save-exact / -E)

filter.description: pnpm workspace filter pattern (e.g., '@scope/pkg', './packages/foo'). Only used with pnpm.

force.description: Force reinstallation of all packages (maps to --force)

frozenLockfile.description: Fail if lockfile needs updating — for CI workflows (maps to --frozen-lockfile for pnpm/yarn, --ci for npm)

global.description: Install packages globally (maps to --global / -g). Use with caution — may require elevated permissions.

ignoreScripts.description: Skip lifecycle scripts (preinstall/postinstall). Defaults to true for safety. Set to false if packages need postinstall scripts to run (e.g., esbuild, sharp).

legacyPeerDeps.description: Ignore peer dependency conflicts (maps to --legacy-peer-deps, npm only)

noAudit.description: Skip the automatic audit step to speed up installation. Only npm runs an audit during install, so this maps to --no-audit on npm. On pnpm and yarn it is a silent no-op (audit is a separate command, not part of install).

packageManager.description: Package manager to use. Auto-detected from lock files if not specified (pnpm-lock.yaml → pnpm, yarn.lock → yarn, otherwise npm).

production.description: Install only production dependencies (maps to --omit=dev for npm, --prod for pnpm, --production for yarn)

registry.description: Registry URL to install from (maps to --registry, e.g., 'https://npm.pkg.github.com')

name: install

lockfileChanged.description: Whether the package manager lockfile changed during install

packageDetails.description: Specific packages that were added, removed, or updated (best-effort parsing)

previousVersion.description: Version that was replaced, when the package was updated in place (action: "updated")

packageManager.description: Package manager that was used (npm, pnpm, or yarn)

title: Install Packages
